page.layout: One text block of running Latin in one column. Notes in the right margin beside lines 6 and 12 (Hebr. 11., Ioan. 4.). Left margin holds only show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page, which are omitted. Top right has a handwritten figure, omitted. Foot: signature at left, catchword at right.

main_text.p: tum malum nos circumsideat opprimatque, nisi ad Deum contendamus: quanta bonorum innumerabilium in Deo suauitas: quanta in Ecclesia claritas: quanta in communione sanctorum delectatio, mutuis celeusmatis inter se adhortantium: quanta vis maximæ illius nubis testium (vt Apostolus ad Hebræos vocat) nosHebr.11. velut circumsonantis clamore sanctissimo in cælo & terra, vt præeuntes sequamur & obsequamur Domino. Hæc cogitatione armati fugiamus nosipsos & mala nostra, ad Deum transfugiamus per Ecclesiam eius, & alij alios ad participationem admirabilis eiusdem lucis religione & charitate vera provocemus. Hæc illa est sanctorum actio, quam Deus imperat, quam Dauid prædicat, quam pius quisque diuinam iudicat, & quam nemo nisi impius, si viderit aut modo aliquo senserit, abdicaturus est.

Sed hanc actionem animus non corpus, mens non manus præstare potest; quandoquidem (vt docebat Christus) Deus est Spiritus, & eosIoan.4. qui ipsum adoraturi sunt, in spiritu & veritate præcipit adorare. Det nobis idem qui præcipit, vt corpore, & animo, & spiritu ita comparati, à nobis ad ipsum in Ecclesia fugiamus indefinenter, & alij alios secundum illam charitatem Christi adiuuemus in persequenda percipiendaque illa communicatione gratiæ, incredibilem lætitiam, fructum spiritus suauissimum, in nobis edicturam.

page.notes: The asterisk-like mark after "Domino" in the first paragraph is a printed symbol, read as Domino with a mark; treated as a printing ornament, not a reference. Handwritten figure at top right and the edge of the neighbouring page on the left are not transcribed. Catchword and signature read from the foot of the page; the catchword is the printed "2. Qvod" including its section number.
